title: Document the slice worktree workflow
lead: Write down how roadmap items move from the slicer queue to a reviewed branch, so humans and agents follow the same process.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: The owner set a per-slice process during ob-02 (git worktree per item, commit in the worktree, slicer handoff for review). It is not recorded anywhere in the repo, and slicer's implement_finish is still `done`, so agent guidance tells agents to skip review.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Add CONTRIBUTING.md covering setup (slicer merge drivers), picking an item, creating `.worktrees/<id>`, running slicer with `--root`, building and testing, committing in the worktree, handoff with a review note, filing discovered work and slicer friction, review and merge, and cleanup. Link it from README Local development. Set implement_finish to handoff. Ignore `/.worktrees/`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: `slicer check` passes; `slicer config implement_finish` prints handoff; commands in CONTRIBUTING.md match `slicer --help` and the repo scripts.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit in the ob-09 worktree; hand off; do not merge or push.
